title: GNSS interference monitor from u-blox telemetry and ADS-B NACp
summary: A stdlib heuristic scorer turns per-epoch receiver telemetry (C/N0 across SVs, AGC, CW jamming indicator, clock and position jumps, receiver spoofing/jamming flags) into jamming and spoofing scores with stated reasons. A pyubx2 adapter feeds it live from UBX NAV-SAT, NAV-STATUS, NAV-CLOCK, MON-RF and SEC-SIG. A second stdlib module applies the GPSJam percentage method to readsb aircraft.json NACp for area-level interference maps.
verified: scorer.py, adsb_area_map.py and 15 unit tests ran on 2026-11-06 (14 stdlib with python3.14.7; the full set incl. test_ubx_replay with pyubx2 1.4.1 on Python 3.12.14); negative controls: cn0_drop weight 0 fails test_broadband_jamming, disabling NAV-SAT parsing fails test_ubx_replay. ubx_monitor.py replay mode ran on a synthetic UBX capture generated with pyubx2 (gen_synthetic_ubx.py, invented values): jamming 60-89 s and spoofing 120-159 s were flagged on every epoch, clean epochs stayed clean. Not verified: live u-blox receiver (--port/--enable, CFG-VALSET), real recordings, real readsb feed.
